name: odile
description: Keep your agent inside the calls your API (or AI model API key) allows with Odile Gate (a key and allow-list per app, rate limits, a loop breaker for runaway agents, per-user rules, Gate Actions run permissions with approvals), set up from inside the coding session; let an agent message or book a business that has no API (Odile Direct); and give an app a real phone line, 25 cents a minute, through the Odile MCP server.
